decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (T358/AP001 Rev. A (Site Location), T358/AP001 Rev. A (Plan & Elevations), T358/AP002, and T358/AP003; received 12 April 2010) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the block pavers to be used in the repaving of the footpath hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 4 - The existing timber doors at either end of the arch shall be retained.
Condition : 5 - There shall be no exterior lighting of the building.
Condition : 6 - There shall be no advertisements displayed outside of the arch (including A-boards, flags and banners).

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the land restored to its former condition on or before two years of the date of this permission unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The use hereby permitted for a temporary sales office shall not be carried on outside the following times: Monday to Friday 10:00am to 8:00pm, Saturdays, Sundays, Public and Bank Holidays 10:00am to 6:00pm.
description: Change of use from B1 use workshop to A2 use to operate a temporary sales and information centre.
